about_short_description.short_description: DocVita scales telehealth in India further with a platform that connects consumers with generalists and specialists across a wide network.

product.name: Online Therapy Services
product.description: A platform connecting individuals with licensed therapists for online counseling sessions addressing various mental health conditions.

product.name: Online Psychiatric Consultations
product.description: Online consultations with verified psychiatrists for diagnosis, medication management, and mental health treatment via video calls.

product.name: Therapist Matching Service
product.description: A service that matches users with therapists based on their specific mental health needs and preferences.

product.name: Care Team Support
product.description: Personalized support from care managers who assist users in finding providers, scheduling appointments, and managing their therapy journey.

product.name: In-Person Therapy Appointments
product.description: Booking and attending in-person therapy sessions at physical locations for clients preferring face-to-face mental health care.
